status: PROPOSED colour sets (unlockable palettes). Each set gives every domain its own regions of OKLab; the six-family truth in colour_domains.json is untouched and still governs the original palette.
space: OKLab, x = [L, a, b] of the sRGB colour (Bjorn Ottosson 2020)
rule: TWO-PIGMENT DOMAINS. A domain is two regions, its rim pigment and its face pigment. A pigment is one paint seen from shadow to highlight: lighting scales a colour's linear RGB, which moves it along a ray from black in OKLab, so a pigment is the cone segment of colours with L0 <= L <= L1 whose chroma direction (a/L, b/L) lies within rho of (sat cos hue, sat sin hue). A colour belongs to a domain when it lies in either of that domain's pigments; a colour in no pigment is unclaimed by the set. The rules every set keeps: (1) any two pigments of different domains are at least margin apart in OKLab (the band); (2) their chroma directions are at least pigment_gap apart beyond their rho (no light or shadow turns one domain's pigment into another's); (3) a domain's rim and face differ in hue by at least min_hue_contrast degrees and in mid lightness by at least min_lightness_contrast (the hue contrast between a prism's rim and face); (4) every rim pigment's swatch rests in its own family of the colour_domains.json truth, clear of the band (the domain still reads as itself).

prism_mapping.rim: SO_ColorSet DomainColorSet.InsideBlockColor and its shielded twins: the prism's fresnel rim (_BrightColor). 'Inside' is a legacy name for the rim (Docs/PALETTE.md section 2).
prism_mapping.face: SO_ColorSet DomainColorSet.OutsideBlockColor and its shielded twins: the prism's base face (_DarkColor).
prism_mapping.fire: Fire and Lime are not DomainColorSets: Fire is EnvironmentColors.Danger (the danger rim over the domain's shielded face), Lime is the CTA pair (BrightCTA rim, DarkCTA body). How a set paints them is an open decision (see open).

unity: Tools/Build/author_colour_set_assets.py writes each set as Assets/_SO_Assets/Color Palettes/<Name>ColorSetSO.asset (Dart Frog: DartFrogColorSetSO.asset). Every field keeps OriginalColorSetSO's brightness, alpha and tier whiteness and takes its hue from one pigment of its domain; Danger wears the Fire rim, BrightCTA and DarkCTA both wear the Lime rim, ElementalCrystalColors are copied. --check fails on drift or on any field that lands in another domain's pigment. To try a set, put its asset in ThemeManagerDataContainer.asset's ColorSet slot.

dart_frog.name: Dart Frog
dart_frog.by: Garrett (Jade from his photo of a green-and-bronze Dendrobates auratus); the other five laid out under the same rules

fire.inspiration: Oophaga pumilio 'Blue Jeans': strawberry-red body, denim legs

gold.inspiration: Dendrobates leucomelas (bumblebee): yellow bands on black, the black given a violet hue so the face keeps a hue

lime.inspiration: a dart-frog pairing: acid lime over oxblood

jade.inspiration: Dendrobates auratus, green-and-bronze (Garrett's photo): measured mint L 0.63-0.89, C/L 0.08-0.10, hue 148-178; bronze L 0.32-0.55, C/L 0.18-0.21, hue 46-58
jade.photo_coverage: Mint surrounds 76% of the photo's mint pixels and Bronze 86% of its bronze. The greyest quarter of the mint (C/L under about 0.075) lies in the six-family truth's Jade/Lime band, so rule 4 stops Mint reaching it.

blue.inspiration: a dart-frog pairing: azure over forest green

ruby.inspiration: a dart-frog pairing: orchid over deep petrol

open: Lime as the CTA pair: DarkCTA paints about 93% of a free crystal, so a face pigment there makes free pickups read as oxblood. The Unity asset keeps the CTA lime on both halves for now; the Lime face (Oxblood) has no field.

Fire as danger: danger is a shared rim over each domain's shielded face, so Fire's own face pigment (Denim) has nowhere to go in SO_ColorSet today. The Unity asset paints Danger with the Fire rim (Strawberry) only.
The free colour-blind sets (protan, deutan, tritan) need the same rules applied to the simulated colours; colour_sets.py --report already prints how this set fares under each.
